text: how does that compare to an average of our other files. because it does feel like a ton of comments but its probably just because the file is literally a book
resolution: Compared 3d.zig's comment density against non-generated framework/gpu Zig peers, all other framework Zig sources, and active cart/editor TypeScript using per-file tokei reports. The comparison uses aggregate ratios and per-file medians to avoid misleading averages, excludes the generated 162,693-line icon atlas, and shows that 3d.zig is moderately comment-heavy rather than anomalous: 15.99% versus roughly 12–14% for Zig peers, ranking third among twelve 1,000-plus-line GPU files. No repository files were changed.
